title: PeacemakersInvoicePacket
description: Sealed invoice packet from ChatGPT (or paste). Write-only handoff — no repo read access required.

email.description: Customer email for Stripe invoice delivery

sku.description: Catalog SKU key (e.g. ai_opportunity_blueprint). See billing/stripe-catalog.json skus.

product_id.description: Optional explicit Stripe product id (overrides sku catalog product)

price_id.description: Optional explicit Stripe price id when amount matches catalog

amount_cents.description: Amount in cents. Required for custom_quote SKUs (implementations). For Blueprint, omit to use fixed $3,500 catalog price.

amount_override_cents.description: Explicit override flag amount. When set, invoice uses this amount even if it differs from catalog.

invoice_title.description: Short invoice description / title shown on Stripe invoice

line_description.description: Line item description (verbiage from sales chat)

memo.description: Optional footer / memo on the invoice

agreement_template.description: PandaDoc template key from billing/pandadoc-templates.json. Null/omit skips PandaDoc.

agreement_fields.description: Optional field map for PandaDoc template tokens

client_slug.description: Optional folder slug under billing/clients/. Derived from client_name if omitted.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the packet was created

idempotency_key.description: Stable key to prevent duplicate draft invoices
